algorithm.flatten: For each trip sorted by stop_sequence: departure(first), arrival(next), departure(next), ... arrival(last); exclude first arrival and final departure. Missing flattened fields would be skipped (none observed).
algorithm.floor: floor raw HH:MM:SS to whole minute (rawSeconds // 60 * 60)
algorithm.cumulativeClamp: clamped_i = max(clamped_(i-1), floored_i), with initial previous value 0
algorithm.comparison: signed event delta = cumulativeClampSeconds - rawSeconds; duration delta is projected adjacent interval duration minus raw adjacent interval duration; no time wrapping or trip removal

limitations: Reproduces the identified minute-floor and cumulative-maximum transformation over only the 168 raw-anomaly trips. It does not run Nigiri, does not establish parity with the pinned binary, and is not policy acceptance.
